headline: China's Export Curbs on Tungsten Threaten Global AI Chip Supply Chains
summary: Reported export curbs by China on tungsten, a critical mineral for high-performance semiconductors, represent a direct escalation of geopolitical trade tensions. This move directly impacts the AI chip supply chain and semiconductor fabs globally, forcing manufacturers to urgently reassess material sourcing and supply chain resilience.

headline: Taiwan Weighs Tighter AI Chip Export Controls to China, Aligning with US Policy
